title: Sales outreach tracking on Mac: how to focus on selling not admin
metaTitle: Sales outreach tracking on Mac for B2B reps
description: Stop losing time on manual sales outreach tracking. Use Lazur to manage your CRM data, email, and research tasks directly from your Mac.
intro: Sales outreach tracking is often the biggest barrier to hitting your quota. You spend your day buried in CRM updates and email triage instead of talking to prospects.
tldr: B2B sales reps spend only 28% to 30% of their week on direct selling.
Manual data entry and tool switching consume most of your workday.
Lazur lives in your Mac notch to help you manage data and research by voice.

blocks.text: Your Mac is your primary office. You likely keep a browser open with HubSpot, Salesforce, or Zoho CRM. You jump between LinkedIn Sales Navigator and your email client. This context switching kills your momentum. You might waste time searching for a lead's phone number or copying data from a website to a spreadsheet.
Why sales outreach tracking feels like a chore

The core issue is friction. When you have to manually copy a name, title, and company from a website and then paste it into a CRM field, you lose focus. You might have 8 to 10 tabs open. You lose your place. You forget to log a call. This is why sales outreach tracking becomes a task you push to the end of the day.

When you use Lazur, you keep your hands on the keyboard. You do not need to click through complex menus to find the right field. If you are looking at a prospect profile in your browser, hold Option plus Command. Ask Lazur to summarize the key details or explain where the contact information is located. Lazur will draw a circle around the relevant part of the screen so you can see it instantly.
Managing your daily sales workflow on macOS

You likely use tools like Maccy for clipboard management or SideNotes for quick thoughts. These are great, but they do not help you process information. Lazur acts as a bridge between your apps. It sees what you see. If you are stuck in a complex CRM interface, ask Lazur to guide you through the process of creating a new lead. It will wait for you to click each step.

If you handle sensitive prospect data, remember to follow your company's data privacy policies. Lazur only sees your screen when you hold the shortcut, and it does not store your screenshots or audio. It is a tool to help you work faster, not a replacement for your own due diligence.
blocks.title: Stay compliant with your company rules

blocks.text: How to use voice for better sales outreach

Dictation is more than just typing. Hold the fn key to start speaking. You can draft a follow-up email to a prospect in Gmail while looking at their LinkedIn profile. You can keep your tone professional and consistent. Lazur formats your speech into clean text at your cursor. You do not need to worry about typos or awkward phrasing.

Researching a new account takes time. You visit the company website, check their latest news, and look for recent funding rounds. Then you move to LinkedIn to find the right decision-makers. Lazur can assist with this. Use the Lazur for Chrome extension to run research tasks in the background. It will gather the data and provide a summary. You can then use that information to craft a personalized message.
Avoiding common mistakes in sales tracking

items: Logging calls too long after they happen: You forget the details. Log them immediately after hanging up.
Over-complicating the CRM: Keep your notes concise. Use templates for common follow-up steps.
Ignoring the data: If you do not track your outreach, you cannot see what works. Lazur helps you keep the logs updated so your metrics stay accurate.
Manual entry for everything: Find ways to use shortcuts. If you find yourself doing the same thing ten times a day, ask Lazur to explain a faster way.

blocks.text: What to do next to improve your sales outreach

Start by auditing your current workflow. Write down every step you take to log a single lead. Identify where you stop to think about where to click. That is where you should use Lazur. Hold the shortcut and ask it to point at the field you need. You will find that you spend less time searching and more time selling.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with Salesforce or HubSpot?
faq.answer: Lazur works with any web-based CRM you open in your browser on macOS. It does not integrate directly, but it sees your screen and can guide you through the interface.

faq.question: Is my prospect data safe?
faq.answer: Lazur only sees your screen and hears your audio while you hold the shortcut. It does not store your data, and it is never used to train AI models.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur guides you by pointing at the screen or telling you what to do, but you remain in control of every click and entry.
